quests.instruction: Butter, sour cream, and cottage cheese all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods is usually creamy and kept in the fridge.
quests.explanation: Super! Butter, sour cream, and cottage cheese all belong to this creamy food group!
quests.funFact: It can take gallons of milk to make just a small amount of some foods in this group!

quests.instruction: Apples, bananas, and strawberries all belong to the same food group. What is it called?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: These foods usually grow with seeds and taste sweet or tart.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Apples, bananas, and strawberries are all sweet, seed-bearing foods that belong to the fruit group!
quests.funFact: Many foods we call vegetables, like tomatoes, are actually part of this group too!

quests.instruction: A bowl of banana pudding, a slice of pecan pie, and a cupcake are all served as this part of a meal. What is it?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This part of a meal is the treat everyone saves room for.
quests.explanation: You found it! Banana pudding, pecan pie, and a cupcake are all examples of this treat everyone saves room for!
quests.funFact: This sweet course has been the happy ending to meals for hundreds of years!

quests.instruction: Milk, cheese, and yogurt all belong to the same food group. What is it called?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods usually comes from cows or goats.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Milk, cheese, and yogurt all come from animals like cows, which makes them part of the dairy group!
quests.funFact: This food group is one of the best sources of calcium for strong bones!

quests.instruction: A brownie sundae, jello, and a slice of chocolate cake are all served as this part of a meal. What's it called?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This part of a meal is the treat that comes after everything else.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! A brownie sundae, jello, and chocolate cake are all examples of this final, sweet course!
quests.funFact: Many bakeries exist just to make this one delicious course of a meal!

quests.instruction: Root beer, herbal tea, and fruit punch are all things you do this with. Which word fits?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This word is the opposite of chewing a solid food.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Root beer, herbal tea, and fruit punch are all liquids you sip, the opposite of chewing!
quests.funFact: Some of these liquid foods can also come with bubbles, like soda!

quests.instruction: Chicken, fish, and beans all belong to the same food group. What is it called?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods helps build and repair your muscles.
quests.explanation: Yes! Chicken, fish, and beans all belong to this muscle-building food group!
quests.funFact: This food group helps your body build muscles and heal after you get a scrape!

quests.instruction: Ginger ale, buttermilk, and iced coffee are all things you do this with. Which word fits?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This word describes anything you'd pour from a pitcher into a glass.
quests.explanation: That's right! Ginger ale, buttermilk, and iced coffee are all things you'd pour from a pitcher into a glass!
quests.funFact: The very first one of these that most babies ever try is milk!

quests.instruction: A caramel apple, a scoop of sorbet, and a slice of carrot cake are all served as this part of a meal. Which is it?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This course is the sweet finale that follows the main dish.
quests.explanation: Great job! A caramel apple, sorbet, and carrot cake are all examples of this sweet finale course!
quests.funFact: This sweet course is often the star of birthday celebrations around the world!

quests.instruction: Oranges, grapes, and watermelon all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: This group of foods usually grows on trees, bushes, or vines.
quests.explanation: You got it! Oranges, grapes, and watermelon all belong to this sweet, seed-bearing food group!
quests.funFact: This food group is a favorite of many animals because of its natural sweetness!

quests.instruction: Coffee, sports drinks, and a berry smoothie are all things you do this with, not chew. What's it called?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This is what you call it when a liquid food goes down with a swallow.
quests.explanation: Well done! Coffee, sports drinks, and a berry smoothie are all liquids that go down with a swallow!
quests.funFact: Athletes often have a special one of these to help them after playing hard!

quests.instruction: A candy bar, apple crumble, and a milkshake can all be enjoyed as this part of a meal. Which is it?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This is the treat that often follows a healthy dinner.
quests.explanation: Correct! A candy bar, apple crumble, and a milkshake can all serve as this sweet final course!
quests.funFact: Many families make this sweet course together for birthdays and holidays!

quests.instruction: Tortillas, popcorn, and pretzels all belong to the same food group. What's it called?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods usually starts out as tiny seeds from a plant.
quests.explanation: Super! Tortillas, popcorn, and pretzels all start out as tiny plant seeds, part of the grain group!
quests.funFact: Popcorn is a whole grain that can pop into a snack many times its own size!

quests.instruction: Artichokes, brussels sprouts, and bell peppers all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods is usually savory and green, red, or purple.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Artichokes, brussels sprouts, and bell peppers all belong to this savory food group!
quests.funFact: Some foods in this group were once grown as flowers before people started eating them!

quests.instruction: Bacon, cod, and kidney beans all belong to the same food group. Which is it?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods is a favorite topping for salads and tacos.
quests.explanation: You found it! Bacon, cod, and kidney beans all belong to this hearty food group!
quests.funFact: This food group can come from the land, the ocean, or even the garden!

quests.instruction: Spaghetti, cornbread, and a bowl of oats all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods gives your body carbohydrates for lasting energy.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Spaghetti, cornbread, and oats all belong to this energy-giving food group!
quests.funFact: This food group is often split into two types: whole and refined!

quests.instruction: Potatoes, onions, and peppers all belong to the same food group. Which one is it?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods is usually savory, not sweet.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Potatoes, onions, and peppers all belong to this savory plant food group!
quests.funFact: Doctors say filling half your plate with foods from this group is a healthy habit!

quests.instruction: Lemonade, hot cocoa, and a smoothie are all things you do this with. Which word fits?
quests.question: Drink
quests.hint: This word means something you pour into a cup and sip.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Lemonade, hot cocoa, and a smoothie are all things you pour into a cup and sip!
quests.funFact: Some of these liquid foods are warm, and some are ice cold!

quests.instruction: Bread, rice, and oatmeal all belong to the same food group. What is it called?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods often comes from wheat, corn, oats, or rice plants.
quests.explanation: Yes! Bread, rice, and oatmeal are all made from plants like wheat, corn, or rice, part of the grain group!
quests.funFact: Farmers grow this food group in huge golden fields all around the world!

quests.instruction: Grapefruit, nectarines, and blackberries all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: This is the naturally sweet food group that grows from a flowering plant.
quests.explanation: That's right! Grapefruit, nectarines, and blackberries all belong to this naturally sweet food group!
quests.funFact: This food group is often eaten fresh, dried, or blended into a smoothie!

quests.instruction: Squash, kale, and turnips all belong to the same food group. Which group is it?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods often grows underground or close to the soil.
quests.explanation: Great job! Squash, kale, and turnips all belong to this earthy, savory food group!
quests.funFact: Some parts of this food group, like the leaves, are just as tasty as the rest!

quests.instruction: Cream cheese, mozzarella, and buttermilk all belong to the same food group. What's it called?
quests.question: Dairy
quests.hint: This group of foods starts out as a liquid from a farm animal.
quests.explanation: You got it! Cream cheese, mozzarella, and buttermilk all start from milk, part of the dairy group!
quests.funFact: Some countries have hundreds of different cheeses that all belong to this one food group!

quests.instruction: Beef, shrimp, and lentils all belong to the same food group. What's it called?
quests.question: Protein
quests.hint: This group of foods helps give your body its building blocks.
quests.explanation: Well done! Beef, shrimp, and lentils all belong to this building-block food group!
quests.funFact: Your muscles, hair, and even skin are partly built from this food group!

quests.instruction: Cantaloupe, papaya, and figs all belong to the same food group. What's it called?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: This is the group of foods that's usually sweetest right when it's ripe.
quests.explanation: Correct! Cantaloupe, papaya, and figs all belong to this sweet, ripening food group!
quests.funFact: This food group changes color as a sign that it's ready to eat!

quests.instruction: Cake, cookies, and ice cream are usually eaten at this part of a meal. What is it called?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This part of the meal almost always comes last.
quests.explanation: Super! Cake, cookies, and ice cream are all sweet treats saved for this final, special part of a meal!
quests.funFact: This sweet course usually comes after the main meal is finished!

quests.instruction: Pineapples, lemons, and plums all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Fruit
quests.hint: This group of foods grows from the flower of a plant.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Pineapples, lemons, and plums all belong to this food group that grows from flowers!
quests.funFact: Some foods in this group, like pineapples, take almost two years to grow!

quests.instruction: Cabbage, celery, and beets all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods is picked from gardens, not baked in an oven.
quests.explanation: You found it! Cabbage, celery, and beets all belong to this garden-picked food group!
quests.funFact: Some foods in this group are eaten raw, and some taste best cooked!

quests.instruction: Barley, a slice of sourdough bread, and rice noodles all belong to the same food group. What is it?
quests.question: Grain
quests.hint: This group of foods often grows tall and golden in a farmer's field.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Barley, sourdough bread, and rice noodles all belong to this golden-field food group!
quests.funFact: This food group has fed more people throughout history than almost any other!

quests.instruction: Corn, peas, and green beans all belong to the same food group. Which group is it?
quests.question: Vegetable
quests.hint: This group of foods often grows in a garden or on a farm.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Corn, peas, and green beans all belong to this garden-grown food group!
quests.funFact: Farmers can grow dozens of different kinds of this food group in one single garden!

quests.instruction: Chocolate mousse, a fruit tart, and a bowl of pudding are all served as this part of a meal. Which one is it?
quests.question: Dessert
quests.hint: This course is the reward waiting at the very end of dinner.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Chocolate mousse, a fruit tart, and pudding are all examples of this rewarding final course!
quests.funFact: Some countries have a special sweet course tradition just for birthdays!
